limitations: Synthetic input had zero detections: no positive detection, mask/NMS accuracy or scene robustness conclusion.

unresolved_high_priority: Inherited joystick implementation has no stop-priority latch and can queue activation with or after stop; detached switch ordering also needs correction. V3 only fixes configuration coverage/immutability. A separate arbitration candidate is under investigation and is not staged or promoted.
Hardware on_activate enables actuators and performs homing. No proof that joystick stop interrupts homing; operator must be present with known physical power-stop procedure before any launch.
Actual joint/IMU signs, calibrated zero positions, effort semantics, update timing, baseline standing/stopping and new-policy motion remain unmeasured.
Live Gemini/API-key path and camera/follower integration remain pending.
Optional1 tactile calibration requires hardware the user does not have; Spider walking, reliable standing jumps and other recorded robustness failures remain research boundaries.

preservation.excluded: Disposable Python environments, intermediate build objects and environment dumps; exact source, installed binaries, package reports, selected test binaries/logs and artifacts preserved. Vision/model addendum and baseline archives retained separately.
